text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I didn't really have anything in
particular going on
today, but King Halo has
invited me out to an
amusement park.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Hehehehehe...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's in her signature racewear for some
reason, and what's more, she's been
cackling nonstop.
There's only one
conclusion I can draw from this.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Of course not, you dingus!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Are you still half-asleep or something?
Dust off
that brain of yours! I'm holding
an autograph
session here!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I take out my planner to double-check
my
schedule for the week.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Come along! Let's head over already. I
can't keep
my fans waiting.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Why isn't there anyone queueing up for
me?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
We put out such a gorgeous sign to
advertise it! Why isn't anyone here?! Are
they all simply
ignoring the fact that I'm
having an event today?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Of course. You said yourself in our
meeting that
it's happening this week
on...
choice_data_list: Hey, are you sure that was schedul...
Hey, was that plan really for today?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Wait...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Hmmm?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We look at the sign put out to advertise
the
session. It lists the date as...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Which is why we're here today to scout out the venue and blow off some stress at the park!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Say something, will you?! So what if
we're here
early? It was our day off
anyway!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I'm a first-rate among first-rates—
in fact, I am the
first-rate conqueror of G1 races
across all distances! And it's been
forever since either of us has had a
break.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
It certainly has been a journey fit for a
king.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
And I didn't get here by following in
someone else's footsteps, but by forging
my very own
magnificent... detour of a
path.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Hmph!
choice_data_list: ...We took a bit of a detour today...

text_block_list.text: King!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Are you here to have fun too?! If so, why
don't
you and I burn some rubber in
those go-karts
over—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
What's this?! Your trainer is with you?!
Are you
two here... to work?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Don't you dare! Shh! Shhhhh!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ahem. I'm here to survey the area in
preparation
for my autograph session
tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: My! You're so dedicated to your duties!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, I am. I've just finished my prep
work,
however, so why don't we enjoy
our time here
together?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I grant you permission to
entertain us as
best you possibly can!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
But of course! Is it not your duty to
support me in
every which way you can
at all times?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You've taken my hand and accompanied
me
through the most winding of detours,
and today
will be no exception.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Hehehe. My thanks.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
King Halo has a fantastic day at the
amusement park and, the following day,
hosts her autograph
session with her
usual royal charm.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Some time later...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bzzzt... Bzzzt...

text_block_list.name: King Halo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you for always taking such good
care of my daughter. I've called today
because there's
something I wish to ask
you."

text_block_list.name: King Halo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Do you happen to know whether she
still likes
the same patterns she did as a
child?"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Is someone calling about holding
another
autograph session, perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...I have a feeling I'll be accompanying
King Halo
down this new detour as well.
